B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID.description: Backblaze says this is the equivalent of an S3 access key id, so the same pair serves both APIs. Half of a credential, kept with the other half. The master key the account creates for you does not work with the S3 API; make one. The name is convention.

B2_APPLICATION_KEY.description: The S3 secret access key under Backblaze's own name for it. Shown once, so save it when it appears. There is no rotation in place: create another key and delete the old to revoke its access. The name is convention.
